opus.w: This section only sets aside $1,500,000 for a budget item called 'Mines and minerals.' It does not mention consulting outside parties, public comment, hearings, advisory bodies, rulemaking, or any right to sue. Like other funding provisions, it involves no participation by anyone outside the federal government.
